text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT PD12345 fired for ap-se1.az2 — high GPU eviction rate, latency spike, runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/evictions

oncall-alex: acked. I'm on call. grabbing logs and starting triage :mag: 

pd-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 acknowledged by oncall-alex@redwood

sre-ana: seeing repeated `gpu_eviction` events across nodes ap-se1-az2-{a,b,c}. metrics: eviction_rate 12/min, node_mem_util ~88%, p99 token latency 850ms

oncall-alex: running quick checks
```bash
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=region=ap-se1
kubectl logs inference-redwood-0 -c runtime | tail -n 200
``` 

eng-runtime-priya: is the autoscaler blocked by maxReplica cap? I see HPA max=20 for inference pool.

sre-ana: correct — HPA hit max. if we can bump maxReplicas and add reserved nodes we should absorb the surge.

oncall-alex: patching HPA to 50 now
```bash
kubectl patch hpa inference-pool -n infra -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":50}}'
``` 

oncall-alex: also enabling immediate routing fallback policy for high-memory models to eu-west to relieve ap-se1: `routing.set-fallback --pool ap-se1 --target eu-west --match model:large* --ttl 5m`

incident-bot: routing.update: fallback active for model prefix `large*` -> eu-west (TTL 5m)

eng-runtime-priya: requesting temporary reservation of 4 g5.48x in ap-se1. infra team looped in.

oncall-alex: infra CLI: `infra reserve --region ap-se1 --type g5.48x --count 4 --reason "PD12345 capacity surge"` -> provisioning started (ETA ~3m)

pd-bot: Escalation to eng-runtime-priya due to customer-impacting latency. 1st escalation sent.

customer-success-jamie: drafting customer comms for impacted APAC orgs. I'll send a heads-up to top customers in 15m or when we have stable mitigations. draft:
"We're aware of increased latency for inference in APAC (ap-se1) — we've enabled fallback to eu-west and are provisioning capacity. No data exposure. We'll update in 30 minutes."

sre-ana: after HPA bump and routing fallback p99 dropped from 850ms -> ~220ms for traffic routed to eu-west. eviction rate on ap-se1 still elevated but trending down.

oncall-alex: new reserved nodes are up. rebalancing pods onto reserved nodes now.

oncall-alex: running drain/eviction mitigation: `kubectl cordon ap-node-03 && kubectl drain ap-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to avoid repeated OOMs

sre-ana: eviction rate back to baseline after nodes provisioned and pods rescheduled. keeping fallback active for 5m more to smooth traffic.

eng-runtime-priya: scheduling a rollback of fallback after 5m if metrics remain stable. also logging a follow-up RFC for autoscaler tuning and per-az reserve windows.

customer-success-jamie: sent notices to 3 customers who reported increased latency. they acknowledged, appreciate the quick update :thumbsup:

pd-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 marked RESOLVED by oncall-alex. Summary: transient GPU eviction surge in ap-se1.az2; mitigated by HPA bump, reserved nodes, and temporary routing fallback.

oncall-alex: closing thread. action items: postmortem, update HPA defaults, create autoscaler policy to pre-warm reserved capacity during known traffic patterns. assigning to eng-runtime-priya and sre-ana.

sre-ana: adding notes to incident board. I'll capture graphs and timestamps for postmortem.

eng-runtime-priya: thanks all — good response. we'll do a retro and publish postmortem within 72h.
